channel.title: The Dig — Gate and device benchmarking
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Gate and device benchmarking preset. Today's ranked reading list leads with 2611.22315, a connectivity-aware transpiler that selects routings after coupling-constrained resynthesis and reports 0.62x the two-qubit gates of Qiskit O3 across 55 benchmarks, and 2611.21270, whose Schmidt-time surrogate and QOC-guided search target pulse-level compilation latency under nearest-neighbor XY coupling; both are directly relevant to compiling for a small, sparsely connected spin-qubit QPU. The skim tier then covers 2611.21578 on temporally correlated leakage and cycle-dependent error accumulation for QEC benchmarking and mitigation, 2611.22260 on circuit-level geometry selection for rectangular surface codes under biased noise, 2611.23009 on dual-rail logical-physical boundary compilation with delayed realization binding, 2611.22166 on a common-clock superconducting qubit control scheme, and 2611.21397 on quantitative millikelvin microwave power measurement for cryogenic control-line calibration.
